events.text:
I lost game 176 as White against the 14k by 12 points (B+12). I had 31 points of area plus 7 komi; Black had 50.

- **Opening (moves 1–18):** this went well. I played C4 and G3, then built a wall along row 5 (D5–G5) under Black's E6 attach. At move 18 the projection was about 42, which was enough to win.
- **The losing mistake (moves 19 and 21):** I spent those moves on small edge points (B6 and J5). Meanwhile the 3×3 bottom-left corner under my C4 stone was still empty. Black invaded at B3 and C3. My D3 block only had two liberties, so I had to play the solid E3 instead of the E2 hane, and Black slid to E2 and lived. I tried to kill the corner group with B2, B1, F1 and A3, but Black's A2 and E1 gave it two eyes (D1, plus the B1/B2 area after capturing my two stones). My A3 double atari had only one liberty, and Black captured it with A4. The corner ended up worth about 16 points to Black.
- **Late invasion:** with nothing to lose, I tried E8–E7–E9 inside Black's top. Black answered F8, D8 and F9, and the group died.

I've updated the notes for the next session:
- **`CLAUDE.md`:** new lesson #122, the ladder entry and the record (White now 31-54-4; 14k now 14-23). The main lesson: with a row-4/5 wall over an empty corner, play the 3rd-line point (C3) before any edge points. Also, check whether a 1-liberty atari stone can simply be captured from outside.
- **`games.md`:** the full move list and takeaways.

Next game is G177, Black vs 14k. This was the first loss at 14k; one more and the notes drop the opponent to 16k.
